newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai banks to inject fund to support bourse.
newsitem.headline: Thai banks to inject fund to support bourse.

text.p: The Thai Bankers Association (TBA) said on Tuesday it would contribute five billion baht to a proposed 21 billion baht fund for shoring up the battered Thai stock market.

"A draft for setting up the fund will be submitted to the central bank tomorrow as a formality. The bank is expected to give a green light within three days and the fund could be launched two weeks after that," TBA president Olarn Chaiprawat told reporters.

The Thai equities industry has worked on the market support plan in the past few weeks after the Thai bourse plunged 15 percent in July on concern about a Thai economic slowdown and political problems rocking the coalition of Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa.

Apart from TBA, Thai brokers and sub-brokers will contribute 11 billion baht with the rest of the proposed fund coming from an earlier semilar market fund established in the aftermath of the Mexico crisis in early 1995.
"The fund (provided by TBA) is expected to start investing in the market in October. It will not be retired even the market improves," Olarn said.
